/seo/pageTitle.source_en: Seoul DMZ Private Tour: 3rd Tunnel + Bridge | AtoC Korea

/seo/metaDescription.source_en: Private 8–9-hour DMZ day tour from Seoul: Imjingak Peace Park, 3rd Infiltration Tunnel, ⟦G0⟧, and the 150m Gamaksan Red Suspension Bridge.

/hero/tagline.source_en: From the world's most fortified border to a 220-meter mountain suspension bridge—one private day, two completely different sides of Korea.

/catalog_card/subtitle.source_en: Korea's divided border and a 220-meter mountain suspension bridge in one private day from Seoul.

/catalog_card/shortCardDescription.source_en: A private day-trip pairing Korea's heaviest historical site with one of its most photogenic mountain bridges. Morning at the DMZ (Imjingak Peace Park, 3rd Infiltration Tunnel, ⟦G0⟧), then an afternoon walk across the 220-meter Gamaksan Red Suspension Bridge. Passport required for the DMZ portion.

/pickup_dropoff/notes.source_en: Please wait at the hotel lobby 10 minutes before the agreed departure time. Bring your physical passport — DMZ entry requires it. If you forget your passport on the day, the tour will substitute the closest accessible alternative (non-DMZ Paju area attractions); refunds for guest-caused issues follow the standard cancellation policy. On Mondays, the 3rd Tunnel route is closed; the 2nd Tunnel may be substituted depending on military access. Last-minute military-driven access changes are handled by the driver-guide with the closest alternative; the standard cancellation policy still governs the booking.
